notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
description:
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Gollum.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing the Zombie, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
